answer: I would rather have one Chartered engraving merchant print log with engraving merchants endorsement than ten weaker checks, because 4-year training, 275 supervised sales, theory exam, guild dues is a wall, not a curtain. One failed proof among 729 burns 107 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 78003 POA on every epoch. Follow the atlas back to the office that issued it, follow the beacon back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the cedar back to the year it was filed. The honest path is short; the farm's path is long, expensive, and watched.
